children.text: Participants
ThinkByte: Mukul M, Harsha Thota, Samarpith Rout
Agenda
Learn your feedback and update on evaluation
Discuss next steps about your timelines and purchase interest
Key Takeaways
Decisions were made to update blog indexing, readability scores, and on-page SEO tasks by refining the connection tracker and wireframe statuses.
A proposal to develop and optimize custom GPTs using paid accounts was introduced to enhance SEO, integrate API actions, and potentially drive traffic to client sites.
Progress on the top level tracker was outlined to include keyword research, repository audits, tech SEO elements, and conversion as well as heat map tracking.
New tracker columns for LinkedIn promotion and conversion data were agreed upon, with a strategy to split long-term goals into actionable quarterly milestones as part of the delivery strategy.
Immediate next steps involve team members updating individual trackers, coordinating follow-up meetings, and addressing pending tasks for clients like Synopsys and Growac.
Business Need
Update blog indexing status and content tracking for October blogs and block render to enhance SEO and technical performance.
Develop a comprehensive long-term SEO strategy divided into quarterly action items, including repository updates and custom GPT integration.
Impact
Improved indexing and ranking are expected from timely blog updates and enhanced technical SEO measures.
Custom GPT functionalities are anticipated to drive additional traffic with SEO-optimized prompts and integrated API actions.
Feature Mention
Introduction of a custom GPT creation feature with public/private options, SEO optimized branding, and API integration (e.g., email, search volume).
Inclusion of conversion tracking and heat map analysis as part of the overall SEO features was discussed.
Team Size
Competitor
Competitors for the ads manager keyword include major brands like Facebook, Google, Apple, Snapchat, and Shopify, which currently dominate the rankings.
Budget
The possibility of charging extra for custom GPT functionalities was mentioned.
Decision Making
Content tracker updates and SEO task completions are directed by Mukul and Harsha, with inputs from Rahul, Tarun, and other team members.
Timeline
Biomarkers pages are already live, while solutions pages are expected to go live within the next few days, with a follow-up review 3-4 days post-upload.
Tracker updates are targeted for completion within the same day, with subsequent review meetings scheduled.
Risk
There is a risk of delayed content updates and indexing errors which may negatively impact SEO performance.
Technical risks exist if subscription limitations prevent the creation of custom GPT features.
Positive Moment
The discussion on custom GPT features generated positive interest regarding their potential to enhance traffic and branding.
Pain Point
Action Item
Mukul M

Update the top-level tracker and delivery sheet with detailed client action items including long-term and short-term goals, additional columns (e.g. LinkedIn promotion) and current statuses as discussed.
Follow up with Pawan regarding his availability to join the call and update on any related changes, as indicated by the discussion.
Inform Rahul and Tarun via email or group ping about the updates in the tracker so that they add their respective portions.
Samarpith Rout

Update the overall tracker/delivery sheet with complete tracking details (including LinkedIn promotion, conversion analysis, user behavior/heat maps and other SEO activities) and ensure that individual client statuses are visible.
After completing the updates on the tracker, ping the SEO team group to inform everyone that the table is updated.
Harsha Thota
Review the overall tracker and monthly report structure for each client (including technical SEO, on-page elements, and conversion/heat map tracking) and ensure they reflect the discussions.
Sai Rahul Tanniru
Update his portion of the tracker with relevant details such as blog repository and keyword performance as per the delivery sheet.
Once the tracker updates are complete, ping the SEO group to confirm completion.
Tarun Sai damerla
Assist in compiling the monthly report for Synopsys by aggregating top search queries, impressions, average volume, and attaching an Excel link with necessary screenshots.
Update the statuses in your individual trackers (including blog tracker and prompts tracking) as discussed.
Create a separate planning and tracker sheet for Superk, Aida, and Oleg, and include a link to the blogs tracker as part of the overall setup.
Client Engagement
Adopt a holistic marketing approach aligning client branding with SEO.
Ensure regular updates and clear communication on individual client trackers.
Content Plan
Monthly plan includes 6 blogs and LinkedIn posts for Nirugian.
Top-level tracker to update content repository and SEO tasks.
Custom GPT Development
Custom GPT creation is enabled via paid subscription; free users access public versions.
Custom GPTs can be configured with names, descriptions, instructions, and API actions.
Option to set GPTs as public or private allows indexing and potential extra revenue.
Follow up
Mentioned to connect with Synopsys team on Monday as there was no call on the current day.
